description: doctrine — shows each dispatched seat while it runs. In a herdr session (HERDR_ENV=1) it panes the seat directly; in a contained agent (DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set) it only writes a request file to that mount for a host-side watcher, calling no herdr. With neither set it stands down, costing one process spawn per hook event and nothing else — and that is more than one per seat: Claude Code also fires SubagentStop for its own forked queries (a prompt suggestion after most turns, memory extraction), each with an empty agent_type, so a session that dispatches no seats still spawns roughly once per turn. SessionStart after /clear (matcher clear) runs dctr-restore.mjs: when SESSION_MEMORY.md's kickoff names a handoff whose record's last state line reads Open or Blocked, it hands the new session the phase, the record path, that state line, the wrapper and the handoff as facts; otherwise it prints nothing and calls no herdr. PostToolBatch runs dctr-gauge.mjs: while that record is Open or Blocked, its last auto-cycle on/off line is on and no .doctrine/auto-cycle.stop exists in the session's repo or the record's, it reads the main session's context use and, the first time it reaches the record's tier, hands the session the warning as facts and appends `- auto-cycle: warned <session id> <tier>` to the record, once per session id; a seat's batch (agent_id present) and every other case stand down, and it calls no herdr. While auto-cycle is on it also reports, on every batch, each tier or window error and each unknown context reading as facts, in additionalContext plus a systemMessage. Stop, Notification (matcher permission_prompt|idle_prompt), StopFailure and UserPromptSubmit run dctr-cycle.mjs, the auto-cycle hook: each stands down, as does a subagent's event, unless that record is Open or Blocked and its last auto-cycle on/off line is on. A Stop then follows cycleDecision in hooks/dctr-lib.mjs, which owns the order and the conditions: it appends one paused line naming its reason, waits for live work, does nothing, or launches dctr-typer.mjs detached (the hook pausing instead when the transcript it would hand the typer cannot be read), which types /clear and then the /doctrine:doctrine-resume command into the session's herdr pane once focus moves off it. A permission prompt, an API error and an idle prompt nothing explains append a paused line too, as notifyDecision decides. UserPromptSubmit only records where the session's turn ended. Each paused line that stands is alerted once: a systemMessage in the pane and, when the session has a herdr pane, a herdr notification and the `autocycle` sidebar token. With DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set they call no herdr. When SessionStart after /clear injects, it also records the record's line count as the session's start and, when HERDR_PANE_ID is set, writes a restore file under TMPDIR/dctr-autocycle, which the typer waits for.
